name: pi-telegram-tts
description: TTS synthesis provider for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Registers a synthesis provider against the bridge's public voice API so getVoicePromptContribution works. Direct `fetch` to the configured provider (MiniMax or OpenAI) — no bundled scripts, no bin field, no per-provider sub-block. The LLM's reply is the only dynamic field; all other API params are hardcoded constants in synth.ts. Configure via telegram.json#extensions["pi-telegram-tts"] (3 fields: disabled, provider, composeWithText).
